cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08, while evidence_sources use record_id values s01 through s08.
Observed Job 2 priorities all have upstream_rank: 0 despite evidence_sources carrying rank values 1 through 8.
In generated/protocol_2_2/upstream_demand_provenance.py, assemble_provenance appends "record_id": record.get('source_id', ""), causing provenance record identities to become source ids.
Behavioural criteria require preserving deterministic source provenance identities and preserving upstream provenance order.
initial_receipt.explanation: The downstream output contains priorities with upstream_rank 0 for every retained need, even though the supplied provenance handoff has ranks 1 through 8. The immediate cause is that the upstream evidence_sources handoff uses source ids as record_id values (s01 through s08) instead of preserving the need record identities (n06-r01 through n06-r08). Job 2 then cannot match coverage record_ids to evidence_sources record_ids. The supplied source supports localizing this to job_1 assemble_provenance, which sets evidence_sources record_id from record.get('source_id') rather than record.get('record_id').
